# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## cand_0002 (unverified until RESULT)
- Pre-filled target cells are legitimately CHANGED in many passing val tasks (11276, 28-7, 304-35, 409-45, 45896, 524-31, 534-26, 535-20, 52541, 56921). Any "keep pre-filled values" rule must stay conditional or diagnostic, never absolute.
- Only 8/394 dataset tasks have golden == init across the answer range (none in val), so "output unchanged ⇒ reading wrong" is a safe guard.
- 51680's golden keeps a header's trailing space and overwrites the worked examples; treat it as noise.

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## cand_0002 attribution (verified from its traces against the cand_0002 RESULT)
- What didn't (cand_0002): the "workbook wins" decision table → 11276 used the sheet's custom weekday codes over the instruction's "Mon, Wed" example, despite the written exception. The pre-filled-changed rule → 59511 fitted a formula to the worked examples from the wrong source column.
- What worked (cand_0002 fixed): the full target-range print (279-23), the 0-changed diagnostic (374-31), the header-derived item list (547-43), and "the asker's formula range defines the data rows" (59129).
- Promising (cand_0003, unverified):
  - a `if v == 0 or v is None` anti-pattern (9391);
  - a plain-ref-is-the-key structured-ref example (45944: key D_r, search the table);
  - sheet spelling for data-value headers (203-15).
